body: City Council Special Closed Session Meeting
agenda_text:
NOTICE AND AGENDA
  FOR SPECIAL CLOSED SESSION MEETING

  CITY COUNCIL
  JULY 30, 2024

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor of the City of Norwalk has called a special closed session
meeting of the City Council beginning at 6:00 p.m. on July 30, 2024 in the City Council Chambers, Norwalk
City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard. The agenda for the special meeting is as follows:

CALL TO ORDER

Mayor Rios

ROLL CALL

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR CLOSED SESSION

CLOSED SESSION

CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT
CODE §54956.9 (d)(4) - Initiation of litigation in one matter.

I, Theresa Devoy, City Clerk, hereby certify that the foregoing notice of special meeting was posted at City Hall not less
than 24-hours before the start of the meeting and delivered to each member of the Norwalk City Council and to the
following newspapers: Herald American, Cerritos Community News, Norwalk Patriot, and Whittier Daily News, all on
July 26, 2024.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk

Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
documents in the agenda packet, can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
Notification of at least 12 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
